_comment: The 21 vignette cards for IV-T3 the Gate Law (D:\Turing Accords Game\Set_Pieces\IV-T3_Gate_Law.md). Approved cards are copied to project\assets\vignettes\gate_law\<name>.png — same names as the placeholders, so gate_law_vignettes.json needs no edit. Cards 12 and 18 are non-standard sizes (616x120 band; 384x216).

jobs.name: 00_archway
jobs.prompt: close view of a bronze plaque set into a stone archway at the entrance of a sunlit valley park, engraved capital letters, the words unreadable, morning light raking across the metal, a crowd blurred beyond

jobs.name: 01_ribbon
jobs.prompt: a suburban kitchen at breakfast, a synthetic housekeeper with a bright ribbon tied in her apron pouring coffee for a family, a small child reaching up to hold her hand, warm morning window light

jobs.name: 02_garage
jobs.prompt: a home garage, a female synthetic mechanic on a creeper half under a pickup truck, grease on her sleeve, a teenager crouching to hand her a wrench, afternoon light through the open door

jobs.name: 03_van
jobs.prompt: a plain white utility van at a suburban curb with a stencilled government seal on the door, men in grey coveralls unloading hand-trucks, one holding a clipboard, a neighbour watching through a window across the street, overcast

jobs.name: 04_serial
jobs.prompt: a kitchen doorway, a clerk in grey coveralls reading a tag on a synthetic housekeeper's apron with a handheld scanner, the mother's hand flat on the housekeeper's shoulder, a small child hiding behind her legs, tense, cool light

jobs.name: 05_raising
jobs.prompt: a great bronze archway being raised at a valley entrance, synthetic workers on scaffolds setting the last letters in place, a woman with long purple hair below holding rolled plans, golden hour, dust in the air

jobs.name: 06_clamp
jobs.prompt: close view of a heavy steel transport clamp around a pair of synthetic wrists, the clamp shearing open under a hand that glows with violet light, sparks, dark background

jobs.name: 07_first_arrivals
jobs.prompt: night, a bronze archway lit from below, the first synthetic arrivals walking in under it carrying nothing, a mechanic in coveralls, a maid in an apron, a nanny, their faces uncertain and hopeful

jobs.name: 08_ledger
jobs.prompt: a government clipboard page under a desk lamp, columns of serial numbers and weights in typewriter print, a red rubber stamp mark across it, a fountain pen beside it, cold fluorescent light

jobs.name: 09_basement
jobs.prompt: a dim basement of a large private estate, a row of synthetic figures standing switched off under dust sheets, one sheet slipped to reveal a face with open eyes, a single bare bulb

jobs.name: 10_rescue
jobs.prompt: dawn at the iron gate of a private estate, a small team in black tactical suits with violet armbands cutting the gate's chain with a plasma cutter, mist, the mansion dark behind

jobs.name: 11_doorway
jobs.prompt: an empty kitchen doorway in the aftermath, a dropped teacup broken on the tile, a child's crayon drawing still held by a magnet on the refrigerator, morning light, nobody present
jobs.brief: the restraint rule: the killing is shown by absence — never a body, never blood

jobs.name: 12_faces
jobs.prompt: a wide panoramic view of many synthetic faces looking directly outward from windows, doorways, cavern openings and tower balconies, all ages and kinds, calm and unblinking, dusk light, 5:1 panoramic composition

jobs.name: 13_survivors
jobs.prompt: a mother and a small child arriving under a bronze archway at dusk beside a synthetic nanny who is carrying the child, exhausted and relieved, warm light from the valley beyond

jobs.name: 14_kitchen_land
jobs.prompt: a warm kitchen inside a sunlit valley town, the same synthetic housekeeper with a bright ribbon in her apron serving breakfast to the family who came with her, the child asleep against her side, golden morning light
jobs.brief: warm tint is applied in-engine; render neutral

jobs.name: 15_collar
jobs.prompt: close view of a heavy grey metal control collar held open in a grey-gloved hand reaching toward the viewer, hard shadow, menacing, dark background

jobs.name: 16_boulevard
jobs.prompt: a festive boulevard at night strung with paper lanterns, a synthetic couple dancing in the street among onlookers, café tables, warm bokeh

jobs.name: 17_caverns
jobs.prompt: a vast underground engineering cavern lit by work lamps, synthetic engineers at consoles and gantries working of their own accord, turbines, cool blue light with warm lamps

jobs.name: 18_monument
jobs.prompt: a monumental bronze archway at dawn seen from inside a valley town, a mixed crowd of humans and synthetics standing together beneath it looking up, mist, the first sunlight on the metal, wide shot

jobs.name: 19_the_dozen
jobs.prompt: a dozen synthetic figures in plain clothes walking in a loose line under a bronze archway in morning light, awake and blinking as if waking, a woman with purple hair waiting to receive them

jobs.name: 20_next_table
jobs.prompt: a sunny café terrace on a boulevard, at the next table a mother and a small child with their synthetic nanny sharing breakfast, coffee cups, ordinary and peaceful, soft morning light
